sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Author a registered full-body garment surface projection atlas from the first supplied fixed model guide. The guide is exactly THREE 512×1024 columns, total 1536×1024: FRONT, right-facing PROFILE, BACK. First image fixes all garment boundaries, human proportions, width, height, head position, hand position, boots, foot placement, margins and camera. Keep positions pixel-aligned across all three columns, transparent exterior, and figure alpha silhouette. The second image is an approved finish reference for Brasswake's realistic soft painted fantasy art. It supplies pigment, lighting and finish only. Restrict the paint changes to clothing. Tunic. Painterly warm ecru linen, a modest gathered seam around neckline, subtly rolled stitched SHORT sleeves, a narrow dark leather belt with one small iron buckle, shoulder seams, controlled asymmetric creases marking natural hanging fabric, and a short sloping lower hem. Dark handmade twill trousers and practical brown low boots. The shirt looks like a real garment with room over the chest. No printed muscles, laced open chest, oversized pouch or stocking shine. Use fine hand-painted pigment and selective outline, varied widths of cloth folds, softly lit warm daylight, matte finish with a few natural highlighted edges. Preserve existing design and body anatomy. Side and back should agree physically with the front; front closures may not reappear at the back. Soft medium-detail brushwork with clear silhouette and readable contrast at final figure height 420 pixels. No external shadows, people or objects outside the three fixed guide silhouettes, no captions, no panel dividers, no ground, no vignette. Its 3D mesh will make the silhouette at runtime. Preserve true transparent alpha and exact layout.
